title: Digital Voltage-Mode Buck (Closed Loop, C++ C-block)
description: Synchronous buck regulated by a digital voltage-mode controller implemented as a QSpice C++ C-block (DPWMCL): sample-and-hold, discrete PI compensator, and digital PWM. Regulates the output to about 5 V.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.video: QSpice for power electronics -- digital closed-loop buck
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: digital_buck_closed_loop.qsch is Alonso's schematic and dpwmcl.cpp his C-block source. digital_buck_closed_loop.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist referencing the DPWMCL device; build dpwmcl.cpp into dpwmcl.dll before simulating. The netlist references QSpice's bundled NMOS.txt/Diode.txt device models by their default install path.

workflows.title: Digital Voltage-Mode Buck (Closed Loop) -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files, build the C-block DLL, then simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
